Türkçe ses üretimi · ses klonlama · beta: Turkish speech generation · voice cloning · beta
SesVer metnini kendi bilgisayarında doğa: SesVer turns your text into natural Turkish speech on your own computer. Pick a ready-made voice, design a new one by describing it, or clone your own voice. No account, no API key, no cloud.
macOS · Windows · ticari olmayan kullanı: macOS · Windows · free for non-commercial use
Yaşlı Masalcı, Belgesel Anlatıcı, Heyeca: Old Storyteller, Documentary Narrator, Excited Host. Synthetic voices designed from a description, not real people.
Yaş, cinsiyet, ton, doku ve hız seç; 4 a: Choose age, gender, tone, texture and speed; listen to 4 candidates and save the one you like to My voices.
Cızırtı, Lo-fi, Telefon, Telsiz, Oda/yan: Crackle, Lo-fi, Telephone, Walkie-talkie, Room/reverb, Megaphone. The raw audio is kept; the processed copy is saved separately.
Sonucu dinle, tek tıkla WAV olarak indir: Listen to the result and download it as WAV in one click. Files are also kept in the outputs/ folder.
Merhaba, ben SesVer. Yazdığın her cümley: Hello, I'm SesVer. I turn every sentence you write into Turkish speech on your own computer, without sending it to the internet.

<strong>Ses örnekleri şu an Türkçe.</str: Audio samples are currently in Turkish. The interface language does not change the speech generation language: VoxCPM2 reads text in the language it is written in (30 languages, including Turkish).
Tek kişinin konuştuğu, müziksiz, temiz 3: Upload a clean 3–15 second recording of a single speaker with no music. If you also enter the recording's transcript, the clone sounds noticeably closer; SesVer can transcribe it automatically too.
Görsel temsilidir; benzerlik değeri bir: Illustrative only; the similarity value is not a measurement and varies with the recording and hardware.

Metnin ve seslerin hiçbir bulut servisin: Your text and voices are never sent to any cloud service. Your personal voices don't even go into Git.
Hesap, API anahtarı veya ücretli servis: No account, API key or paid service needed. Internet is only required during the first setup, to download what's needed.
OpenBMB VoxCPM2: 2 milyar parametre, Tür: OpenBMB VoxCPM2: 2 billion parameters, 30 languages including Turkish, 48 kHz output. A GPU is not required; depending on your hardware you may have to wait.
